tiers.R0: Documentation or non-executable asset changes; no external check required beyond the evidence gate.
tiers.R1: Tests or low-risk scoped changes; at least one external check must pass.
tiers.R2: Normal code or compatible dependency changes; complete build/test/security/native matrix plus static and independent AI review required.
tiers.R3: Public API, migration, release, runtime configuration or major dependency changes; manual maintainer decision required.
tiers.R4: Security-critical, workflow, signing, destructive or large-blast-radius changes; manual maintainer decision required and hard security blockers fail closed.

rules: No force push or ruleset bypass is used.
Failed, pending, stale, cancelled, skipped or unknown required checks fail closed.
A single lint or build success never satisfies the Required Evidence Matrix.
Required checks must come from GitHub Actions with an exact head SHA and workflow-run identity.
R2 auto-merge requires build, test, security, native-if-configured, static review and independent AI approval.
R3 specialist evidence is mandatory; manual review is always required.
R4 requires explicit authorization and is never auto-merged.
AI review unavailable is NOT_VERIFIED, never PASS.
A score never overrides a blocker.
